title: X-Tiller Idea
description: Idea artifact written by idea-capture. possible_pillar is legacy free text kept for backward compatibility; new captures should use possible_pillar_id, the canonical ids defined in profile/content-pillars.md. Existing inbox artifacts that carry only the free-text field remain valid.

possible_pillar.description: Legacy free-text pillar, still required by this schema. Existing artifacts use several vocabularies ('AI and Coding Agents', 'AI productivity and ways of working', 'independent-developer-stack'). Kept unconstrained for backward compatibility; new captures keep it readable but should also set possible_pillar_id, which is the canonical joining key.

possible_pillar_id.description: Canonical pillar id from profile/content-pillars.md. Optional so the four existing inbox artifacts stay valid; new captures should set it.
